title: 📱 Make Responsive
content: Make the design fully responsive across all devices. Use responsive breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px). Stack elements vertically on mobile using flex-col, switch to flex-row on larger screens. Apply responsive grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Adjust font sizes (text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl). Ensure touch targets are minimum 44px on mobile. Add mobile navigation with hamburger menu. Test all interactive elements on touch devices.

variants.simple: Make the layout responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
variants.detailed: Make the design fully responsive across all devices. Use responsive breakpoints: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px). Stack elements vertically on mobile using flex-col, switch to flex-row on larger screens. Apply responsive grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Adjust font sizes (text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl). Ensure touch targets are minimum 44px on mobile. Add mobile navigation with hamburger menu. Test all interactive elements on touch devices.
variants.advanced: Make the design fully responsive with mobile-first approach. Breakpoints strategy: base (mobile), sm:640px (large phones), md:768px (tablets), lg:1024px (laptops), xl:1280px (desktops), 2xl:1536px (large screens). Layout patterns: flex-col sm:flex-row for horizontal groups, grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 for cards. Container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8. Typography scaling: text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl for heroes, base sizes for body. Touch targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for all interactive elements on mobile. Navigation: hamburger menu (Menu/X icons) on mobile with Sheet or slide-out drawer, full nav on lg:. Images: w-full h-auto with aspect-ratio containers. Tables: horizontal scroll on mobile or card-based layout. Forms: full-width inputs on mobile, inline on desktop. Hide/show elements: hidden md:block, md:hidden. Sidebar: off-canvas on mobile, fixed on lg:. Test with Chrome DevTools device toolbar, actual devices for touch interactions.
